mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 2.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate rise above 2.5% within a 3-month window signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 149000.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a housing starts decline below 1200 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when HOUST < 1200 and the regime is late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above 109.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when INDPRO > 109.0.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level above 510000 million dollars indicates strong consumer spending, fueling corporate revenue growth and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when RSAFS > 510000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and retail sales (RSAFS > 510000) indicates robust consumer and housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 510000.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate decline below 2.0% within the last 10 days compresses short-term discount rates, causing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.
